independence_disclosure.prior_role_disclosure: This same agent previously authored the John canonical/premortem blind route.
independence_disclosure.contamination_risk: Prior-route memory may influence this replacement literary route even though the route was re-reasoned from the strategy and direct USFM only.
independence_disclosure.admissible_use: May serve only as the requested third literary-device lens; must not be represented as a blind cross-model vote.

method.route_principle: Prefer genuine literary movements identified by scene reset, speaker turn, sign-response development, festival frame, discourse cadence, investigation sequence, intercalation, passion-stage movement, appearance, purpose close, and epilogue form.
method.anti_chunking_guard: No fixed verse-window or uniform-size chunking was used; unit lengths vary with the direct literary evidence.
method.form_hierarchy: Every route unit belongs to one macro parent; larger super-parents and composite investigation/intercalation parents preserve cross-unit designs.
method.alternative_policy: Every unit includes at least one exact containing-span alternative for rejection of the finer seam.

composite_investigation_and_intercalatio.rationale: The repeated interrogations delay recognition and make the shepherd discourse answer the expulsion scene.
Peter’s first denial, Annas hearing, and paired denials are distinct scenes whose crosscut order forms one trial-denial frame.
Pilate’s repeated movements and staged exchanges produce a composite hearing while supporting finer dramatic units.

hardest_seams.literary_issue: poetic light-dark cadence gives way to prose witness introduction
birth/receiving stanza turns to embodied Word and first-person witness
opening exposition closes and dated testimony narrative begins
Cana descent closes; Passover ascent opens a second sign-response complex
temple saying fulfillment comment yields to an untrusted-belief summary
earthly/heavenly saying creates a possible speaker and form transition
discourse cadence followed by relocation and concurrent baptizing scene
self-disclosure is interrupted by disciple arrival and woman departure
persecution rationale becomes an extended solemn-answer defense
boat arrival closes the sea sign; next-day crowd pursuit resets time and place
promise cadence is answered by narrated complaint
council dismissal abuts a received-coordinate textual hot zone
received-coordinate scene closes before light discourse begins
investigation ends in expulsion; Jesus hears and initiates recognition dialogue
